image.name: code-server
image.description: [Code-server](https://coder.com) is VS Code running on a remote server, accessible through the browser. - Code on your Chromebook, tablet, and laptop with a consistent dev environment. - If you have a Windows or Mac workstation, more easily develop for Linux. - Take advantage of large cloud servers to speed up tests, compilations, downloads, and more. - Preserve battery life when you're on the go. - All intensive computation runs on your server. - You're no longer running excess instances of Chrome.

changelog.desc: Add fallback for legacy or misconfigured systems without IPv6 support.
Fix container only listening on IPv6 when running non-root.
Let server listen on both ipv4 and ipv6.
Allow setting PWA name using env var `PWA_APPNAME`.
Only chown config folder when change to ownership or new install is detected.
Manage permissions in /config/.ssh according to file type
Rebase to Ubuntu Noble.
Deprecate armhf. As announced [here](https://www.linuxserver.io/blog/a-farewell-to-arm-hf)
Install recommended deps to maintain parity with the older images.
Rebase to jammy, switch to s6v3. Fix chown logic to skip `/config/workspace` contents.
Install using the official tarballs.
Add `install-extension` as a helper for mods to install extensions.
Add `DEFAULT_WORKSPACE` env var.
Rebase to Ubuntu focal.
Fix slow `chown` on large workspace (contents of workspace folder no longer chowned).
Bump node to 14 to fix builds
Fix doc link
Allow setting gui password via hash using env var `HASHED_PASSWORD`.
Allow setting sudo password via hash using env var `SUDO_PASSWORD_HASH`.
Add --domain-proxy support.
Shrink images, install via yarn, fix arm32v7 build.
Switch to multi-arch images, install via npm.
Update start arguments.
Structural changes required for v3.
Fix artifact url retrieval from github.
Upgrade to v2 builds.
Update project logo.
Add development builds/tag.
Add optional sudo access.
Add nano.
Initial Release.

env_vars.name: PASSWORD
env_vars.desc: Optional web gui password, if `PASSWORD` or `HASHED_PASSWORD` is not provided, there will be no auth.

env_vars.name: HASHED_PASSWORD
env_vars.desc: Optional web gui password, overrides `PASSWORD`, instructions on how to create it is below.

env_vars.name: SUDO_PASSWORD
env_vars.desc: If this optional variable is set, user will have sudo access in the code-server terminal with the specified password.

env_vars.name: SUDO_PASSWORD_HASH
env_vars.desc: Optionally set sudo password via hash (takes priority over `SUDO_PASSWORD` var). Format is `$type$salt$hashed`.

env_vars.name: PROXY_DOMAIN
env_vars.desc: If this optional variable is set, this domain will be proxied for subdomain proxying. See [Documentation](https://github.com/coder/code-server/blob/main/docs/guide.md#using-a-subdomain)

env_vars.name: DEFAULT_WORKSPACE
env_vars.desc: If this optional variable is set, code-server will open this directory by default

env_vars.name: PWA_APPNAME
env_vars.desc: If this optional variable is set, the PWA app will the specified name.

image.title: Code-server
image.setup_instructions:
Access the webui at `http://<your-ip>:8443`.
For github integration, drop your ssh key in to `/config/.ssh`.
Then open a terminal from the top menu and set your github username and email via the following commands

```bash
git config --global user.name "username"
git config --global user.email "email address"
```

### Hashed code-server password

How to create the [hashed password](https://github.com/cdr/code-server/blob/master/docs/FAQ.md#can-i-store-my-password-hashed).

snippets.docker_compose:
---
services:
  code-server:
    image: ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/code-server:latest
    container_name: code-server
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=Etc/UTC
      - PASSWORD=password #optional
      - HASHED_PASSWORD= #optional
      - SUDO_PASSWORD=password #optional
      - SUDO_PASSWORD_HASH= #optional
      - PROXY_DOMAIN=code-server.my.domain #optional
      - DEFAULT_WORKSPACE=/config/workspace #optional
      - PWA_APPNAME=code-server #optional
    volumes:
      - /path/to/code-server/config:/config
    ports:
      - 8443:8443
    restart: unless-stopped
snippets.docker_run:
docker run -d \
  --name=code-server \
  -e PUID=1000 \
  -e PGID=1000 \
  -e TZ=Etc/UTC \
  -e PASSWORD=password `#optional` \
  -e HASHED_PASSWORD= `#optional` \
  -e SUDO_PASSWORD=password `#optional` \
  -e SUDO_PASSWORD_HASH= `#optional` \
  -e PROXY_DOMAIN=code-server.my.domain `#optional` \
  -e DEFAULT_WORKSPACE=/config/workspace `#optional` \
  -e PWA_APPNAME=code-server `#optional` \
  -p 8443:8443 \
  -v /path/to/code-server/config:/config \
  --restart unless-stopped \
  ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/code-server:latest
